reviews.title: Worth every penny.
reviews.comment: They’re quiet and look beautiful. If you’ve done your research. You already know how dope these fans are. And I know you’ve done your research if you’re here. I’ve been running them for about 4 months now. No issues. Came with so many extra parts (power cables) If you haven’t done your research these are one of the best fans for aesthetics and airflow. In my opinion of course. Absolutely the way to go.
